Future<String?> run(rows, String? cursor) async {
 for (final row in rows) { cursor = await client.next(row, cursor); }
 return cursor;
}
Future<void> reset(rows, String? cursor) async {
 for (final row in rows) {
  cursor = null;
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  cursor = await client.next(row, cursor);
 }
}
Future<void> perItem(rows) async {
 for (var row in rows) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
  row = await enrich(row);
 }
}
